title: Guild Board 1.5.1
sub: PATCH NOTES  ·  TO-DO LIST, QUEST SHARING AND A DUNGEON TAB

rows.label: NEW
items: Left-click the minimap button. Your own checklist with an arrow to the next stop. Quests tick themselves off.
Right-click, then Party & Upkeep. Repairs, bags, turn-ins and group quests in one window.
Share any quest a party member can take. Ask for one they have and it gets shared for them.
Opens by itself when you zone in. Who needs to repair, where everyone is, bosses down.

rows.label: CHANGED
items: Left-click is now the To-Do List. Dungeons moved into the right-click menu.
Party tab shows 5 at a time. More shows 20. Skip drops one, and you can bring it back.
New menu button. Asks everyone online to resend their info. No typing.

footer: Update from the pin in #addons  ·  Fully restart WoW after  ·  /gb bug to report issues
